info.text:
Anthropic wants to be worth up to $1.4 trillion.
On Nov 10 it set its IPO range at $70-$78 a share: 825M shares, up to $64.4B raised.
The $1.4T counts every share that could exist (fully diluted).
Sales: $33.2B in the first nine months of 2026 vs $4.6B in all of 2025.
It has had only one quarter of operating profit, and says that growth rate isn't expected to last (CNN, prospectus).
If you buy once trading starts, you pay the market price: SpaceX priced at $135 and first traded at $150.
Sources: Fortune, CNN (Nov 10, 2026), AP, Anadolu Agency.
News and education, not financial advice.
